verdict.summary: Every recorded fact matches the customer email, the mailroom-confirmed attachments, the Policy Schedule and the Veridia contract; the claim was reported within 5 days, falls under covered C2, has all required documents, no exclusion, and the commercial-vehicle playbook referral rule is not triggered, so the staged payment (deductible €700, payout €1,700, assessor booked) should be approved.
